failure_summary.description: One call used a shortened tool identifier, and two selected weather endpoints that did not best match the requested result.
Calls missed a selector or used values or required/optional placement that differed from the endpoint schema or canonical form.
The response included general DEI influencers but omitted the separately requested education-topic influencer results.

patch.reasoning: The observed patterns are already covered by the skill’s instructions on exact tool identifiers, endpoint capability matching, coverage ledgers, canonical parameter values, and required-versus-optional placement. Additional rules would duplicate existing guidance; some unmatched expected optional values were not requested and should not be added.
